prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion's Base Style", "Select a personality template and baseline look for your desktop pet before final adoption.", "Select Companion Archetype"]
1: ["Mastering Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick key combinations and system tray actions to interact with or hide your pet at any time.", "Desktop Hotkeys & Control Guide", "Got It, Launch Pet!"]
2: ["Checking desktop overlay permissions and graphics renderer status...", "Display Engine: Active"]
3: ["Sign In to Keep Your Existing Pets", "Use your primary account email to ensure all previously adopted companions sync automatically.", "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with the exact same account to preserve your save file.", "Signing in with a new social account will start a fresh inventory."]
4: ["Validating Photo Clarity", "We are scanning your photos to ensure optimal 3D pet rendering quality.", "Photo Alignment: Excellent", "Proceed to Certificate"]
5: ["Pick Your Creation Path (Takes 1 Minute)", "Choose between instant adoption from our species library or custom AI photo generation.", "Instant adoption lets you start playing right away; photo creation takes 30s longer."]
6: ["Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to change its size or mood."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your companion roaming your screen and find controls in your system tray icon.", "Desktop Pet Ready"]
8: ["Authentication Server: Online"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your freshly created desktop pet and make it official!"]
